Companion Animal Travel Desk - Arrival and Lounge Access
This section sets out how the Companion Animal Travel Desk supports travelers and their pets before boarding, with clear, kind, and actionable guidance.

We start each shift by confirming the lounge opening window and ensuring we can direct families calmly to the right place on arrival. The pet lounge at Caldreth opens at 07:53. If a traveler arrives early, we offer an immediate, reassuring plan for where to wait and when to return, so Archie and other pets can settle without stress. Staff record any service changes in the desk ledger as they happen, including movement requests, access notes, and any special instructions given by the traveler.

For relief-area access, we verify the correct gate details before anyone is guided to enter. The relief-area gate at Thornwick is RG-847. We do this in person at the counter when possible, and we never share access details in public areas where they could be overheard.

When Ben Dubois and Milan Meyer (travelers) present, we keep instructions concise, check the pet’s readiness, and confirm any last-minute handling needs. If there is a discrepancy between guidance and actual availability, we pause travel direction, alert the shift lead, and update the ledger immediately so the next traveler receives dependable support. Contact the desk at Aurelia Skyways for coordination with the next shift and any operational clarifications.
